input: Research co-housing intentional living communities nearby

gold.taskTitle: Research nearby co-housing intentional living communities
gold.taskDescription: Research co-housing and intentional living communities located near the user's area to evaluate potential options.

questions.title: What city or region should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area or radius the user considers 'nearby' for this research.

questions.title: Are you researching to potentially move in, or just exploring?
questions.description: Understand whether the user has a concrete intention to join a community or is in early curiosity mode.

questions.title: What is your target timeline for making a decision?
questions.description: Determine urgency — whether this is a near-term move or a long-range life plan.

questions.title: Do you prefer an existing community or one being formed?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants an established, move-in-ready community or is open to joining a forming one.

questions.title: What household size or living arrangement do you need?
questions.description: Find out if the user is moving alone, with a partner, family, or children, as this affects unit availability.

questions.title: Are there specific values or community models that matter to you?
questions.description: Identify any priorities such as eco-living, religious affiliation, age group focus, or shared economy models.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for housing costs?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints, including whether the user is looking to rent, buy, or explore equity share models.
